description: Trafikarbetets förändring is a dataset listed in Geodata Portal Sweden, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by applikation-pt.trafikverket.se. The portal shows the English title as "Changes in traffic management" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include informationssystem, information system. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geodata-se.
